paragraphs.text: Royse is a fae from Eldraine .

Royse appears to be a beautiful fae possessing otherworldly traits. Her home is adorned with fine weaves that are so exquisite they attract admiration from both humans and fae alike. During her interaction with Rowan Kenrith , Royse displays wisdom and enigmatic charm. Despite her fae nature, she offers Rowan hospitality and guidance, showing that she is not an enemy but rather a helpful, albeit cryptic, ally. When not using a glamor disguise, she has eight eyes, two mandibles, and eight arms, two of which appear human. Due to her coveted weaves, she has been bestowed numerous gifts by the fae. She is old by human standards.

Royse engaged with Rowan Kenrith , offering her shelter and food. She questioned Rowan’s refusal of rest, suggesting that it would come eventually whether Rowan accepted it or not. Despite her fae nature and revealing her true spiderlike form, Royse maintained a friendly demeanor and provided Rowan with directions to a nearby castle.
